extraction.Name: Josie Pourier
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County (Pine Ridge area, South Dakota)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but wanted the land held in trust, but that she was told that the patent had been reported to the tax commission, and that whether or not she took the patent, that the land would be taxed and sold if they were not paid
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have the patent recorded, and does not know who did
extraction.Buyer: borrowed $1500.00 from Peters & co, St. Paul, Minn. to pay taxes, and couldn't pay it back so lost the land. This was in 1920.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: borrowed $1500.00 from Peters & co, St. Paul, Minn. to pay taxes, and I couldn't pay it back so I lost the land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is poor owing to stomach trouble; has no property of any kind; has a husband and six minor children supported by herself and husband; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since the patent was issued; document number possibly 769%; subscribed and sworn October 31, 1928
